papers.title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Weikai Xu, Yunren Feng, Haoxiang Lei, Kun Huang, Yuxuan Liu, Kang Zhao, Xiaolin Hu, Shuo Shang, Bo An
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University; University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; Independent Researchers; Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China; Xiamen University
papers.intro: AppDeltaWorld 提出一种基于转换约束的“增量代码”世界模型，通过检索可到达的 HTML 结构参考并生成带图像槽的可执行 HTML，以高保真度预测移动 GUI 的下一状态，并作为训练环境显著提升下游 GUI 代理的决策性能。

papers.title: Curia-MAE: Multi-Modal Multi-Anatomy MAE Pre-Training for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.authors: Théo Danielou, Antoine Saporta, Léo Alberge, Corentin Dancette
papers.affiliations: Raidium
papers.intro: Curia-MAE 通过改进卷积 MAE 的预训练目标（Huber 重建损失、上下文损失、特征正则化和局部-全局相似性目标），在约 30 万 CT/MRI 影像上训练出多模态、多解剖区域的分割基础模型，显著提升了冻结编码器在下游 3D 分割任务上的表现。

papers.title: Activity Frames: Deterministic Screen-Activity Compilation for Agent Memory and Replay
papers.authors: Nossa Iyamu
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文标注为Independent Researcher）
papers.intro: 论文提出一种确定性、零模型的“活动帧”（Activity Frames）编译管线，将被动捕获的屏幕活动流编译为带类型、带证据指针的结构化记忆块，供代理查询和重放，并首次用被动人类活动数据测量了代理成本模型中的例程开销比R和例程重复率h。

papers.title: VSMP-IMU: Video-Grounded Semantic Motion Programs for Sensor-Aware Synthetic IMU Generation
papers.authors: Lala Shakti Swarup Ray, Vitor Fortes Rey, Mengxi Liu, Paul Lukowicz, Bo Zhou
papers.affiliations: DFKI（德国人工智能研究中心）；Vitor Fortes Rey、Mengxi Liu、Paul Lukowicz、Bo Zhou 同时隶属于 RPTU Kaiserslautern-Landau，德国
papers.intro: VSMP-IMU提出以结构化“语义运动程序”（Semantic Motion Program, SMP）作为视频理解与IMU合成之间的中间表示，从活动视频中提取语义并生成可控、标签保持的合成IMU数据，从而在低资源、类别不平衡和跨受试者场景下显著提升HAR模型性能。

papers.title: UniVVT: A Unified End-to-End Framework for High-Fidelity Video Virtual Try-on
papers.authors: Yushe Cao, Shikun Feng, Fei Shen, Haikuo Peng, Jianqiang Xia, Yiheng Zhu, Dianxi Shi, Chun Yu
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, Zhongguancun Academy, National University of Singapore, National University of Defense Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: UniVVT提出了一个将视频虚拟试穿重构为语义条件视频生成的统一端到端框架，通过多模态大语言模型感知器提取任务感知隐式语义，并用轻量语义桥接器将其注入扩散视频生成器，从而在推理时完全无需外部掩码、姿态或服装变形模块。

papers.title: TAU-Bench: From Anomaly Instance Tracking to Fine-Grained Video Anomaly Understanding
papers.authors: Kepeng Yang, Dongxuan Liu, Rongxin Gao, Zixin Su, Rui Wu, Shuzhao Xie, Chenxin Li, Panwang Pan, Yuzhi Huang, Yue Huang, Jingyan Jiang
papers.tags: video segmentation, tracking, instance segmentation, video search
papers.affiliations: 厦门大学（XMU）、清华大学（THU）、香港中文大学（CUHK）、深圳技术大学（SZTU）
papers.intro: TAU-Bench 是一个以轨迹为中心的基准，首次将异常实例跟踪与细粒度视频异常理解联合起来评估，揭示了现有 VLM 在生成合理异常解释时仍普遍存在视觉定位不准确的问题。

papers.title: Beyond Frame Selection: Rethinking Long-Video Understanding with MLLMs
papers.authors: Ziling Huang, Shin'ichi Satoh
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, CLIP, video search
papers.affiliations: National Institute of Informatics, Japan
papers.intro: 本文提出VideoRouter（VR），通过构建问题无关的时间层次结构生成全局和局部两种互补证据视图，并利用验证引导路由自适应地协调二者，从而在有限token预算下提升MLLM的长视频理解能力。

papers.title: StepReflect: Structured UI Transition Reflection for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Linqiang Guo, Wei Liu, Li Gu, Yang Wang, Tse-Hsun, Chen
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, visual question answering, image classification, gui
papers.affiliations: Concordia University, Montreal, Quebec, Canada
papers.intro: StepReflect 将移动 GUI 智能体的每步动作反思重构为基于 UI 状态转换的结构化监督预测问题，用本地 8B VLM 替代昂贵的前沿模型云端反思，在离线转换级精度和在线任务成功率上均可与或超越 GPT-5.2 反射方案，同时大幅降低 API 费用。

papers.title: CoCo-IR: Contextual Composed Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Shengcao Cao, Tanmaya Shekhar Dabral, Zhongli Ding, Madhuri Shanbhogue, Kaifeng Chen, Zhe Li, Mojtaba Seyedhosseini, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Google DeepMind, OpenAI
papers.intro: 本文提出了上下文组合图像检索（CoCo-IR）任务，并设计了基于大型多模态模型的Transformable Image Embedding（TIE）框架，通过专用嵌入token和混合注意力机制将完整交互历史编码为可演进的图像嵌入，配合自动数据引擎，在单轮和多轮检索中均达到了最优性能。

papers.title: Objects as Audio-Visual Modal Sound Fields
papers.authors: Zisen Shao, Zihao Wei, Derong Jin, Ruohan Gao
papers.affiliations: University of Maryland, College Park
papers.intro: 本文提出AV-MSF（Audio-Visual Modal Sound Field），一种结合3D Gaussian Splatting和物理可解释的模态参数的物体级声场表示，能够从多视图图像和极少量冲击录音中重建物体的冲击声场，并支持新位置声音合成、接触定位和物体声音编辑。

papers.title: SmartMage: Dynamic Modality Orchestration for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Yue Zhang, Yingzhao Jian, Yunqiu Xu, Xiaoxiao Sun, Hehe Fan
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University; Stanford University
papers.intro: SmartMage提出一种语义引导的动态模态编排框架，通过SMART全局模态路由和MAGE模态感知专家分配，在3D场景理解中实现查询自适应的多模态融合，并在多个基准上达到最优性能。

papers.title: IRIS: A Visual Cortex-Inspired Framework for Analyzing Orientation Selectivity in Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Vaishnavi B Mohan, Vijayakrishna Naganoor, Yashas Annadani, Shashank Hegde
papers.affiliations: Vaishnavi B Mohan - University of Washington, USA; Vijayakrishna Naganoor - Microsoft, USA; Yashas Annadani - TU Munich, Germany; Shashank Hegde - Nvidia, USA
papers.intro: 论文提出IRIS，一套受神经科学启发的方向选择性分析框架，通过RSS、ORS、OSI和HWHM等指标系统测量ViT各层表征中的方向编码，发现预训练目标是方向选择性最强的决定因素，并据此提出一种基于机制的层解冻微调启发式方法。

papers.title: Lesion Detection in CT with Frozen Self-Distilled Features: SALT, a Spatially Adaptive Label-Guided Temperature
papers.authors: Mahmut S. Gokmen, Evan W. Damron, Mitchell A. Klusty, Caroline N. Leach, Emily B. Collier, V. K. Cody Bumgardner
papers.tags: object detection, medical image, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: University of Kentucky（前五位作者）；University of Louisville（V. K. Cody Bumgardner）
papers.intro: 本文提出SALT（Spatially Adaptive Label-guided Temperature），通过弱标签在自蒸馏预训练中空间自适应地锐化教师温度并上调病灶patch的损失权重，使得冻结的编码器特征更集中地编码病变信息，从而仅用轻量级CenterNet式检测头即可在四个CT队列上显著提升…

papers.title: HelloWorld: Enabling Socially Interactive Characters in Video World Models
papers.authors: Liangyang Ouyang, Ruicong Liu, Xuangeng Chu, Kaipeng Zhang, Yoichi Sato
papers.affiliations: The University of Tokyo, Alaya Lab
papers.intro: HelloWorld 提出了一种基于自蒸馏微调和训练时自由时间交叉注意力掩码的视频世界模型，使生成角色能够在用户按下按钮后，在指定时间窗口内面向镜头执行多种社交互动，同时保持高质量的相机轨迹跟随和画面美学。

papers.title: VQ-VAD: Vector-quantized Motion Representation Learning for Human-centric Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Narges Rashvand, Ghazal Alinezhad Noghre, Shanle Yao, Gabriel Maldonado, Hamed Tabkhi
papers.affiliations: University of North Carolina at Charlotte（北卡罗来纳大学夏洛特分校），Electrical and Computer Engineering Department
papers.intro: VQ-VAD将原本用于图像生成的VQ-GAN适配到关键点序列上，通过学习正常行为的离散运动码本，将观测序列映射到码本时的重建误差作为异常分数，实现了在域内、跨域和跨数据集三种场景下均表现优异的姿态驱动视频异常检测框架。

papers.title: Beyond Reprojection Error: Camera Calibration with 3D Targets
papers.authors: Dennis Ruppel, Hasan Kutlu, Kai A. Neumann, Martin Knuth, Pedro Santos, Andreas Weinmann, Arjan Kuijper
papers.affiliations: Fraunhofer Institute for Computer Graphics Research, Darmstadt; Technical University of Applied Sciences Würzburg-Schweinfurt（Computer Vision, Imaging and Data Analysis Group）; Technical University Darmstadt（Mathematical and Applied Visual Computing）
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种以场景射线预测为核心的相机标定框架，通过新型3D二十面体靶标和基于射线的交点误差、重建误差指标，证明了其相比传统2D平面靶标与重投影误差能带来更高的标定精度和更好的3D重建评估效果。

papers.title: A Paragraph is Worth a Thousand Captions: Rethinking Text Supervision for Vision-Language Retrieval
papers.authors: Mahyar Ghazanfari, Amin Tabrizian, Arsyi Aziz, Binshuai Wang, Peng Wei
papers.affiliations: The George Washington University
papers.intro: 通过冻结视觉编码器、仅微调文本编码器的受控实验，系统研究了从单标题到多句段落的文本监督粒度对对比图像-文本检索的影响，发现段落监督无需任何架构修改即可在长描述基准上匹配或超越Long-CLIP，并揭示了长序列利用能力的成因。

papers.title: OmniEdit-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Instruction-based Video Editing
papers.authors: Chenxuan Miao, Yutong Feng, Yi Lu, Yunfeng Yan, Donglian Qi, Shiwei Zhang, Yu Liu, Xi Chen, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong; Wan Team, Alibaba Group; Zhejiang University; Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个覆盖空间、时间、音频、参考和推理五个轨道的综合指令视频编辑基准 OmniEdit-Bench，并引入以准确性为前提的评分机制，实现对编辑质量的更可靠评估。

papers.title: Promptable Animal Pose Tracking Across Species
papers.authors: Le Li, Daniela Ivanova, Nicolas Pugeault
papers.affiliations: School of Computing Science, University of Glasgow
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于视觉基础模型的“可提示”动物姿态跟踪框架，用户只需在单个参考帧中标注关键点，即可通过监督或无监督两条路径在视频序列中跨帧跟踪这些关键点，在跟踪精度与跨物种泛化之间取得平衡。

papers.title: "Allow" to Achieve, Over-Privileged Inadvertently: The Unintended Cost of Task-Completion-Driven Pop-up Decisions in Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Dongsheng Chen, Yuxuan Li, Guanhua Chen, Jiaxin Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao, Lei Ma, Xin Yao, Xuetao Wei
papers.affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology（南方科技大学）；City University of Hong Kong（香港城市大学）；The University of Tokyo（东京大学）；Lingnan University（岭南大学）
papers.intro: 本文通过在AndroidLab真实任务中注入Android风格权限弹窗，系统评估了四个前沿多模态大语言模型驱动的移动GUI智能体的"权限素养"，发现它们存在任务条件化的应用信任偏见（App-Trust Bias）、任务优先覆盖（Task-Prior Override）以及提示词缓解手段的不稳定性，并…
